decision.observation: Forward throttle only nudged the car to 1 mph in gear 1, red X lit, with trunks crowding the left and ahead. The road with the STOPP banner runs up-left, about a screen away, with blue boulders to the right.
decision.hypothesis: Forward is blocked by pines, so the car must be pulled straight back along its own axis out of the trees before any realignment; steering during reverse has previously driven it deeper.
decision.memory: W+A among the pines barely moves the car. Reverse without steering is untested here for escaping a treeline, and steering while reversing has twice pushed it further in.
